verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents webhooks that notify developers of real-time events, and its webhooks docs say notifications are sent "any time an event happens in your app," so it directly provides an event stream systems can act on. However, the pack never names the specific lifecycle events or describes delivery reliability. Missing for 10: an enumerated event list covering renewal, upgrade/product change, payment failure and cancellation, reliability guarantees (retries, idempotency, authentication/signing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every subscription state change — renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation — emits a webhook or event my systems can act on reliably

citations.quote: RevenueCat can send you notifications any time an event happens in your app.
Get notified of real-time events through webhooks.
